🌟 *Top 5 of the Day*

1. *Cauvery dispute continues: Mandya farmers block highway with empty pots as Karnataka bandh Day 2 sees mixed response*
   _The Cauvery row remains a street-level flashpoint on both sides of the border; the judicial relief window keeps slipping — meaning the political pressure valve stays open with no court-mediated solution in sight._

2. *Monsoon Session ends: Parliament passes 12 Bills including MMDR mines amendment; opposition states threaten Supreme Court challenge*
   _The MMDR Bill is the most consequential centralisation of mineral revenue in years; with states already in SC, a follow-on fiscal fight between the Centre and mineral-rich states is now inevitable._

3. *Tata Motors gains 2.27% as group consolidates after Chandrasekaran exit; TCS continues to weigh on the conglomerate*
   _The Tata leadership vacuum is transmitting into index-level volatility while individual listed entities are splitting on fundamentals — a fragmented conglomerate creates real pricing dislocations traders can act on._

4. *PM Modi lands in Sweden for two-day visit; Rahul Gandhi's 'hug diplomacy' jab triggers BJP fury*
   _Modi is packing three continents of diplomatic capital into a single week while the Opposition attacks the very medium of his outreach — the framing fight matters as much as the deals being signed._

5. *Apple trains a China-specific AI model with Alibaba support; Databricks hits $190B valuation on $5B raise*
   _The Apple-Alibaba tie is the first major US-tech-on-Chinese-cloud deal that openly navigates the chip and tariff walls — every other frontier-lab operator is watching what they get away with._
